responsibility: Auto-generated documentation-link table for the ARC backend’s target options declared in arc.opt. It maps individual ARC command-line switches such as -mcpu, endianness, FPU, code-density, tuning, and extension-selection options to URL suffixes for the GCC manual’s ARC Options section, letting GCC’s generated option metadata associate each option with its manual anchor; it is produced by regenerate-opt-urls.py from arc.opt and the generated HTML docs rather than implementing option semantics itself.
